en-US.description:
Your phone is now a form coach.

Prop it up, start a set, and FormCheck draws a live skeleton over your body, counts every rep, and tells you out loud what to fix — "go deeper", "chest up", "push your knees out". Every rep gets a score, every set gets an A–F grade.

MEET BONES
Bones is your skeleton coach. He watches your joints, not your outfit, and he never gets tired of counting.

HOW IT WORKS
• Prop your phone side-on, about 2.5 m (8 ft) away
• Lift like normal — the live skeleton tracks you in real time
• Hear instant voice cues and see what went wrong
• Get a grade for every rep and every set
• Export slow-mo skeleton replays to share

FOUR LIFTS
• Squat — depth, forward lean, knee tracking (front view), tempo
• Deadlift — hip timing, bar path, lockout
• Overhead Press — full lockout, leaning back
• Lunge — depth, upright torso
Bodyweight squats and lunges count too — no barbell needed to try it.

WATCH YOURSELF IMPROVE
Every set is saved with its grade. See your sets this week, your best grade and your streak right on the home screen.

100% ON YOUR PHONE
There is no server for your video. All pose analysis runs on-device with Apple's Vision framework. Your camera feed never leaves your phone. No account needed.

FREE & PRO
Free: one fully-scored set every day.
FormCheck Pro: unlimited sets on all lifts, replays and history. Yearly plan includes a 7-day free trial, and we send a reminder 2 days before it ends. Weekly plan also available. Payment is charged to your Apple Account; subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel anytime in Settings → Apple Account → Subscriptions.

FormCheck gives informational feedback about exercise technique and is not medical advice. Lift within your limits.
